contentBody: **A startup defines its audience as "Men and women aged 18–45 interested in fitness." What is the biggest problem?**
option.2: The audience is probably too broad to reveal a specific customer need or behaviour
option.3: Fitness cannot be used for segmentation
option.4: Target audiences should never include age
answerExplanation: The range is so wide that it does not reveal one need or behaviour to build the offer around.

contentBody: **A company says: "Our software uses an advanced proprietary machine-learning algorithm." Which rewrite gets closest to customer value?**
option.2: We are India's most innovative technology company
option.3: Our software identifies high-priority leads so sales teams spend less time chasing low-intent prospects
answerExplanation: Customer value is the outcome for the user. Model counts, innovation claims, and "cutting-edge" stay at feature or slogan level.

contentBody: **You ask AI to create a customer persona. What should happen next?**
option.2: Immediately build the campaign around it
option.3: Validate its assumptions using real customer and behavioural data
option.4: Ask AI to create a logo for the persona
answerExplanation: An AI persona is a hypothesis. Real customer and behavioural data have to confirm it.
